## Verification

**Audit verdict:** `confirmed`

**Checked on:** 2026-09-09

**Checked by:** audit cycle 36 (AR2) — DRIVEN in a real browser

**Code evidence:**

- 🔑 agents/routing.py:1-6 THE TITLE IS THE GUARANTEE — 'suggest the right specialist, NEVER ROUTE SILENTLY' — and the consent line is explicit: 'The user consents; NOTHING ABOUT THE SESSION CHANGES UNTIL THEY CLICK'
- :8 deterministic-first with the LLM out of the hot path, borrowing 'the calibrated shape from workflows/surfacing' rather than inventing a scoring scheme
- 🔑 STAGE 1 CARRIES AN EXTRA PRECISION GUARD MOST IMPLEMENTATIONS SKIP: a keyword-only hit 'additionally requires the matched phrase to carry ≥3 words (SHORT-MESSAGE SPURIOUS-MATCH GUARD)'. And the 0.7 gate is skills.loader._MIN_TRIGGER_OVERLAP — one calibrated constant shared, not a second threshold
- 🔑 STAGE 2 REQUIRES A MARGIN, NOT JUST A SCORE: the top score must clear the confidence gate AND beat the runner-up by ≥0.1 'SO AMBIGUOUS FITS STAY SILENT'. Silence on ambiguity rather than a coin-flip suggestion
- the embedding stage is 'skipped entirely when no embedder is bound', so a machine without one degrades to keyword-only rather than erroring
- :19 'Never raises into the send path' — the send outranks the suggestion
- MEASURED: tests/test_agent_routing.py passes 15/15, covering the clause's list — keyword hit, embedding hit, low-confidence None, no-embedder fallback, reserved agents never candidates
- test_agent_routing 15/15; test_config_roundtrip 17/17

**Notes:** The margin rule is the design decision worth keeping. A confidence gate alone makes a two-way tie into a suggestion, and a wrong suggestion in a default-agent chat costs more than no suggestion — so the second condition converts an ambiguous classification into silence. That is the same never-fabricate posture the approval matcher takes with 'nothing matched is its own answer'.
